import itertools, random, sys, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("main", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
main = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(main)

def pipeline(rib, ixps=()):
    paths = main.aggregate(rib, set(ixps))
    links=set()
    for p in paths:
        for i in range(len(p)-1): links.add(main.canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
    rnd, core_paths = main.peel(paths)
    core = sorted(links - set(rnd))
    if not core: return None
    var_of={k:i for i,k in enumerate(core)}
    try:
        factors, scopes = main.build_factors(core_paths, var_of)
    except KeyError:
        return None
    return core, factors, core_paths

# exhaustive search over multisets of length-3 paths on n nodes
def search(n, plen, maxcount=2, limit=None):
    nodes=list(range(1,n+1))
    allp=[p for p in itertools.permutations(nodes, plen)]
    found=[]
    if limit is None:
        combos=itertools.product(range(maxcount+1), repeat=len(allp))
    else:
        rng=random.Random(limit); combos=(tuple(rng.randint(0,maxcount) for _ in allp) for _ in range(200000))
    for cs in combos:
        if sum(cs)==0: continue
        rib=[{'path':list(p),'count':c} for p,c in zip(allp,cs) if c]
        r=pipeline(rib)
        if r is None: continue
        core, factors, cp = r
        if len(core)>10: continue
        Z=main.partition_value(factors, list(range(len(core))))
        if Z==0:
            found.append((rib, core))
            return found
    return found

n=int(sys.argv[1]); plen=int(sys.argv[2]); mc=int(sys.argv[3]); lim=int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv)>4 else 0
print(search(n,plen,mc,lim or None))
